_comment: Runtime plugin dependencies for the SDLC CORE pipeline. Read by pipeline-orchestrator/SKILL.md (Step 0a) at the start of /sdlc:start, which aggregates this file across EVERY installed plugin. Declare only what THIS plugin's own runtime invokes — a plugin that mandates a skill declares it itself (see android-foundation/runtime-dependencies.json). This is OUR custom preflight mechanism, separate from Claude Code's native plugin.json/dependencies array, which only handles intra-marketplace install-time resolution. Authoring-time skills are deliberately NOT listed: /sdlc:create-pluguin invokes superpowers:writing-skills, but the preflight runs on /sdlc:start and must not warn about a tool this run will never call.

dependencies.name: superpowers
dependencies.fallback_note: The orchestrator skips its skill-discovery step (SKILL.md Step 3b-1a) and agents fall back to their own frontmatter guidance.
